notes.title: Altushka + Release Today! New Characters Coming Soon!"
notes.content:
[h1]Altushka + Release Today! New Characters Coming Soon![/h1]

We are thrilled to announce that Altushka + is officially launching today! Immerse yourself in a unique anime simulation experience like no other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006872/d8e96ce27b619a239f068db05af71f6d0431ec24.png[/img]
But that's not all – we are already working on new updates to bring even more excitement to your gameplay. New characters are in development, each with their own unique stories and features, ready to join the Altushka + world soon.

Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more updates and content coming your way!
